name: ArangoDB MCP
tagline: Query ArangoDB multi-model data from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The ArangoDB MCP server. Run AQL queries, manage documents, traverse graphs, and explore schemas. Document + graph in one engine, one query language.
longDescription:
## What it is

The ArangoDB MCP server. Exposes ArangoDB as MCP tools: run AQL (ArangoDB Query Language) queries, list collections, manage documents, traverse graphs, and inspect query plans.

## Why we recommend it

If you use ArangoDB, this is the simplest way to give an agent access. The agent runs AQL — which works for documents, graphs, and key-value in a single query — and gets back typed results.

## When to use it

- AQL queries: agent writes a query, runs it, reports results
- Graph traversal: agent uses AQL graph patterns to find paths
- Schema exploration: agent lists collections and inspects indexes
- Document CRUD: agent creates, updates, and deletes documents
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. ArangoDB Community is free. ArangoDB Cloud has a free tier.
